paragraphs: In the morning, assess a client and review heart rate and oxygen uptake. At midday, write the prescription and set intensity zones. During supervised exercise, correct movement and breathing and verify safety. Review outcome curves and revise the plan several times. Follow up in the afternoon, adjust the program, and organize the case list before the next day's assessments.
